primary_cities_note: Location_only package: primary_cities = the 42 analyst-approved target suburbs (data-driven, VIC, Pakenham excluded). validate_selection.check_consistent_secondary_city treats any suburb outside primary_cities as a 'secondary city'; for a suburb-grid package the target suburbs ARE the primaries (same convention as other location clients).

suburb_constraints.prioritise: commercial-activity / business suburbs (office, retail, industrial density) — client example: Dandenong
suburb_constraints.note: Commercial-cleaning silo (70%) needs business/commercial suburbs, not residential-density. Pakenham HARD-excluded (Q15 — too far). Phase 2 data-driven discovery should weight commercial intent.

location_silos_note: BDM brief: 60 location keywords split commercial x suburb (70% = 42) and steam/carpet x suburb (30% = 18). Phase 0/1 should honour this split when allocating the service-head x suburb grid.
